📱 Clean up your phone and organize your storage smarter with CleanX.

From duplicate photos and similar videos to large files, overflowing inboxes, and messy contact lists, CleanX helps you remove unnecessary clutter, free up storage space, and keep your Phone organized with less effort. Whether your Phone storage full warning keeps appearing or you simply want to clean out your phone faster, CleanX helps make storage management easier and more organized.

🖼️ REMOVE DUPLICATE PHOTOS & CLEAN VIDEOS FASTER

Your gallery can quickly fill up with duplicate photos, similar images, repeated videos, screenshots, bursts, and unnecessary media that take up valuable storage space.
Remove duplicate photos and similar images, clear repeated videos, sort large files by size, and free up storage space more efficiently without manually searching through your gallery.

👆 ORGANIZE PHOTOS IN SECONDS

Organizing your gallery should feel simple and natural.
If you are looking for how to clear up space on Phone, CleanX helps simplify the entire cleanup process.

🎥 FREE UP SPACE WITH VIDEO COMPRESSION

Running low on storage? Compress videos to make them smaller and save space for new photos, videos, and apps without manually managing large files.

📂 FIND LARGE FILES & FREE UP STORAGE SPACE

Large videos and storage-heavy files can silently consume your phone storage. Get more storage on Phone by identifying large and unnecessary files taking up space in your gallery.

📉 REDUCE VIDEO SIZE WITHOUT LOSING QUALITY

Save storage without losing important memories.
Compress videos to reduce file sizes while maintaining visual quality and choose exactly which videos you want to optimize.

👥 ORGANIZE CONTACTS & BACK THEM UP SECURELY

Merge duplicate contacts, remove unnecessary contact information, create secure backups, and restore previous contact lists anytime with less effort.

🔒 KEEP PERSONAL FILES SAFE & PRIVATE

Keep personal photos and videos protected inside a secure private space designed for sensitive content you want to keep separate from your gallery.

🛡️ PRIVATE, SAFE & DESIGNED FOR CONTROL

Your privacy and control always come first.
CleanX is designed to help you clean, organize, and optimize your Phone safely while keeping your personal data protected and fully under your control.

📴 NO INTERNET NEEDED

CleanX works directly on your device, so you can clean and organize your Phone anytime without needing an internet connection.

💳 SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

Payment will be charged to Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
